name: browsers
description: The browsers connected through the efferent extension, with their names, and what each has done this session. reload true reloads the extension in one browser after its files were edited.

browser.description: Which connected browser, by its name in browsers. Defaults to the first one connected.

name: tabs
description: Every tab in a browser: yours (in your own window) and the person's, marking the one they used last. Sign-in popups are marked.

browser.description: Which connected browser, by its name in browsers. Defaults to the first one connected.

name: open
description: Open an address. With no tab it opens in a new tab of your own window, which stays behind the person's windows (show true brings it to the front instead); with tab it navigates that tab. Answers with the page's elements by ref.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the last tab you opened or used in that browser.

browser.description: Which connected browser, by its name in browsers. Defaults to the first one connected.

name: read
description: A tab's title, address and interactive elements by ref. find keeps only the elements and text lines (with the lines around them) holding every one of its words, with | between alternatives ('out of 5 stars | Add to cart'); text true adds the page's words.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the last tab you opened or used in that browser.

max.description: Most elements to list, 150 by default.

browser.description: Which connected browser, by its name in browsers. Defaults to the first one connected.

name: act
description: Run steps in a tab in order, waiting for the page to settle after each, and answer with what ran and the page after. Steps: {click: ref or visible text}, {fill: ref, value} (text box, dropdown by option text, checkbox true/false, rich editor), {type: text} (into the focused field), {press: "Enter" | "ctrl+a" | "Escape"}, {hover: ref}, {scroll: pixels or ref}, {go: address}, {back: true}, {forward: true}, {reload: true}, {upload: ref of a file field or drop zone (or empty for the page's first), files: [paths]}, {wait: ms or "text to wait for"}. A target can also be "css:selector". Add trusted: true to a click, type or press (or to the whole call) for real input through the debugger. When a step opens a popup or new tab (Sign in with Google), the next steps run there, and you return to the page when it closes.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the last tab you opened or used in that browser.

name: upload
description: Put files from this computer into a page: a file field, or a drop zone, by ref or visible text; with no to, the page's first file field. Fast: no file picker opens. Up to 64 MB a file.

tab.description: Tab id. Defaults to the last tab you opened or used in that browser.

name: screenshot
description: A picture of a tab. Slower than read: use it for layout, images and charts.
